info.title: agni API

get.description: Lists microVM applications belonging to the user or all cluster apps.

post.description: Creates a new application with a presigned upload URL for archive submission.

get.description: Returns details of a specific microVM application by ID.

delete.description: Destroys and cleans up a microVM application container and resources.

post.description: Starts the deployment workflow for an app that has an uploaded archive.

get.description: Streams live stdout/stderr logs from the microVM container via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

post.description: Cancels an incomplete multipart upload and cleans up partial parts.
Finalizes a multipart upload by assembling all uploaded parts.
Starts a multipart upload and returns presigned URLs for each part. For files > 100 MB.
Retries a failed deployment from scratch.
Creates a zero-trust share link for an application with specified permission and recipient email.

get.description: Lists all active share links for a specific application.

delete.description: Revokes an active share link by share ID.

post.description: Generates a fresh presigned upload URL for an app.

get.description: Returns cluster health status, active microVM counts, memory allocation, and Go runtime stats.
Returns the profile of the authenticated user from JWT Bearer token or Session token.

post.description: Issues an agent JWT token for MCP CLI client authentication.
Authenticates a user with email and password, returning access and refresh JWT tokens.
Revokes the user refresh token and invalidates the session.

get.description: Validates a magic login link token and sets a session cookie.

parameters.description: Set to false to return JSON instead of 303 redirect
parameters.name: redirect

post.description: Sends a passwordless magic login link to the requested email address.
Reissues a new access/refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.
Registers a new user account with name, email, and password.
Resends verification link to the target user email address.

get.description: Validates session cookie access for a shared application.
Verifies user email using token parameter and returns session credentials.
Returns the subject user ID from the Bearer JWT token.
Serves deployed static assets for an application preview path.
Returns a single user by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing user by ID.
